0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the New York Knicks host the Philadelphia 76ers. The teams split their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the Knicks won their 2025-26 playoff series 4-0, including a 144-114 win in Philadelphia on May 10, 2026. For the 76ers, Ariel Hukporti is out with a ruptured Achilles, Dominick Barlow is out with a back issue, and Tacko Fall is out with a hip injury, while Adem Bona (foot sprain), Anfernee Simons (hamstring) and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
